# Bundled demo assets

SettleX Atlas bundles the following browser assets so the local Buildathon demo
does not depend on public CDNs. They are presentation dependencies only; a
production web build should compile and pin its frontend dependencies.

| Asset | Upstream source | License |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `alpine.min.js` | [Alpine.js](https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine) | MIT |
| `tailwind-browser.js` | [Tailwind CSS](https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss) | MIT |
| `lucide.min.js` | [Lucide](https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide) | ISC |

The files are retained in their downloaded minified form. Refer to each
upstream repository for the complete licence text and version history.
